newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Western Areas declares half yr dividend.
newsitem.headline: Western Areas declares half yr dividend.

text.p: Full name: Western Areas Gold Mining Company Ltd

NOTE - The company said it would issue capitalisation shares to shareholders registered on December 27. The number of new shares to which shareholders would be entitled would be determined by applying to their shareholdings the ratio that 42 cents bears to the weighted average traded price of Western Areas shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange during the three-day period ended January 30 1997.
Based on the calculated price, the total value that each shareholder would receive per share held on the record date would be equivalent to 42 cents.
